title: Mexico’s Attorney General Takes Over Investigation into the Murder of Oaxacan Journalist Alejandro Leyva Aguilar
author: Gustavo Castillo García
content:
_This article by Gustavo Castillo García originally appeared in the[July 23,
2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/07/23/politica/fgr-atrae-
asesinato-del-periodista-oaxaqueno-alejandro-leyva-aguilar), Mexico's premier
left wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City.** The Attorney General's Office (FGR) reported that it
exercised its power to take over the case of Oaxacan journalist Francisco
Alejandro Leyva Aguilar.

"Based on what the Law establishes,**the FGR, through the Specialized
Prosecutor 's Office for Human Rights (FEMDH), will carry out the
corresponding investigations to clarify the case and find those responsible**"
for the journalist's murder. Leyva Aguilar was deprived of his life yesterday
morning while having breakfast at a food establishment near his home, in the
municipality of San Pablo Etla. The journalist, 58, served as director of the
Oaxacan Radio and Television Corporation (CORTV) during the Alejandro Murat
Hinojosa administration and was currently one of the most critical journalists
of the government of Morena member Salomón Jara Cruz.
